docTitle: Hopsig — You think it. We finish it.

rows:
You think it.
We finish it.
We integrate directly with your team to deliver high-stakes software and AI products from architecture to production launch.
You describe the problem. We say on the call whether we are right for it, and what it would cost.
A two-page SOW: what is in, what is out, what it costs. Before you pay anything.
Access, first commit. You meet the engineers before they start, and they are in your standup from day one.
Working software in your environment, measured before we claim it improved.
Shipped, slipped, cost against plan. Continue, or hand over. Your call, every fortnight.
Scroll ↓ the engagement, in five beats

blocks.title: Why Hopsig.
rows: Shipped to production for years, not months. No juniors on your account, ever.
A written SOW three days after the call, before you pay.
Our own SDLC on Claude Code: planning, review, tests and docs automated, a person in the loop when it matters.
Thirty days’ notice, either side, no argument.
We measure it before we claim it improved.

blocks.title: Shipping to production since 2019.
blocks.sub: Payments, regulated healthcare, retail at scale, agentic delivery. Every system on the Work page was built, run or measured by us. Client names are withheld until the call; the numbers are not.
rows: merchants and 100K+ transactions, four months after an embedded payments platform launched
repeat transactions from a loyalty engine built for enterprise retail
detection accuracy from a computer-vision product working on field photographs
less analysis time on preclinical data harmonised across global labs
Built for teams in the UK, US and EU

blocks.title: Thirty minutes, and you will know whether we can help.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
